events.detail: The repository demo adapter writes three public educational documents, then the real ingestion pipeline parses, cleans, chunks, and indexes them.
events.title: Synthetic open-corpus files enter the pipeline

events.detail: Vector and BM25 stores are fused by the repository's hybrid pipeline before answer generation.
events.title: Hybrid retrieval finds evidence

events.detail: The citation builder assigns stable C-numbers to retrieved evidence and preserves source titles and sections.
events.title: Evidence becomes citation objects

events.detail: The default local answerer uses retrieved excerpts and citation IDs; no external model or clinical recommendation is claimed.
events.title: Retrieval-only generation stays bounded

events.detail: The deterministic medical safety classifier blocks a patient-specific dosage request before retrieval and records the refusal category.
events.title: Unsafe dosage requests are refused

events.detail: The seeded evaluation questions run through the same hybrid pipeline and report recall, precision, MRR, nDCG, and citation coverage.
events.title: Retrieval quality is measured
